title: Cancellation of an invertible factor in the evaluation-defined internal Hom
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a symmetric monoidal category [def-sfb-monoidal-category] with unit $\mathbf1$, symmetry $\sigma$, and a specified internal Hom bifunctor $H$ right adjoint to $A\otimes-$ in each first variable, with its natural currying bijections and evaluation maps [lem-pod-closed-uncurry-laws]. Let $L$ be tensor-invertible: there is an object $L^{-1}$ and an isomorphism $L\otimes L^{-1}\cong\mathbf1$. For every object $V$, let
$$
i_{V,L}:H(V,\mathbf1)\longrightarrow H(V\otimes L,L)
$$
be the transpose of the pairing
$$
(V\otimes L)\otimes H(V,\mathbf1)
\xrightarrow{1_V\otimes\sigma_{L,H(V,\mathbf1)}}V\otimes H(V,\mathbf1)\otimes L
\xrightarrow{\mathrm{ev}_{V,\mathbf1}\otimes1_L}\mathbf1\otimes L\cong L.
$$
The associators in this display are the specified ones. Then $i_{V,L}$ is an isomorphism, natural contravariantly in $V$ and with respect to isomorphisms of $L$. This is the specified evaluation-transpose map, not an unspecified choice of an isomorphism between the two internal Hom objects.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sf-invertible-factor-hom-cancellation] with $X=V$, $Y=\mathbf1$, and $J=L$. The given isomorphism $L\otimes L^{-1}\cong\mathbf1$ is one of its inverse-factor isomorphisms; composing the symmetry $L^{-1}\otimes L\xrightarrow{\sim}L\otimes L^{-1}$ with it supplies the other. Under the canonical unit identifications, the theorem's map $s_{V,\mathbf1,L}:[V,\mathbf1]\to[V\otimes L,\mathbf1\otimes L]$ is exactly the displayed transpose $i_{V,L}$: its uncurrying equation is the displayed pairing with the symmetry moving $L$ past $H(V,\mathbf1)$. Hence $i_{V,L}$ is an isomorphism. The cited theorem gives its contravariant naturality in $V$ and compatibility with isomorphisms of $L$, so these clauses hold for the specified evaluation-transpose map.

lean.statement: theorem invertibleHomCancellation (L I : C) (_e : L ⊗ I ≅ 𝟙_ C) : (∀ V : C, IsIso (invertibleHomComparison V L)) ∧ (∀ (V W : C) (f : V ⟶ W), (pre f).app (𝟙_ C) ≫ invertibleHomComparison V L = invertibleHomComparison W L ≫ (pre (f ▷ L)).app L) ∧ (∀ (L' : C) (a : L ≅ L') (V : C), invertibleHomComparison V L' = invertibleHomComparison V L ≫ (pre (V ◁ a.inv)).app L ≫ (ihom (V ⊗ L')).map a.hom)
